thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: High error rate observed for inference egress in region ap-south2. 5xx spike and intermittent connection resets starting ~1823456760. Auto-created incident #INC-2026-042. Paging sre-oncall.

mira: oncall here, seeing ~20% 5xx on the api-proxy cluster for ap-south2. latency up ~2x. digging into egress to peering.

sam: getting paged too. any customers currently routed only to ap-south2? need list for comms ASAP.

jordan: I can pull routing table + recent deploys. running `rds get-routes --region ap-south2 --since 1h` now.

incident-bot: AUTO: Incident severity set to SEV2 due to customer impact over threshold. Recommended initial actions: (1) verify failover policies (2) scale dedicated pools (3) notify customers on status page.

mira: quick findings: egress failures to cloud-peering endpoint peer-172.31.14.2; tcp reset flood. no config changes in last deploy window.

alex: ops note — we had a scheduled maintenance on a peer provider earlier in the day, but it was marked completed. I'll open a peering ticket.

sam: mitigation plan proposal: 1) update smart-routing to prefer ap-south1/ap-southeast1 for incoming requests with region fallback; 2) temporarily increase retry budget and lower batch-size for ap-south2 to reduce transient 5xx; 3) post status page draft.

jordan: routing command to flip preference (dry-run first):
```bash
redwoodctl routing update --region ap-south2 --preference 20 --fallback-regions ap-south1,ap-southeast1 --dry-run
```

mira: i'll run the dry-run and then apply if no issues. will also scale up the dedicated pool in ap-south2 by +2 nodes as a buffer:
```bash
redwoodctl pools scale --pool ap-south2-dedicated --add 2
```

incident-bot: NOTE: When applying routing changes, automatic KV cache warming is paused for 5 minutes. Expect some cold-start latency on affected keys.

comms: draft for status page (please review):
"We are experiencing elevated error rates and increased latency for inference requests routed through ap-south2. Our engineers are investigating root cause and routing traffic to healthy adjacent regions (ap-south1, ap-southeast1) where possible. Some customers may see increased latencies or partial failures while we mitigate. Updates at 15-minute intervals."

sam: small edit suggestion: add affected time window and mention that if a customer has a strict region requirement to reach out to support for options.

comms: updated draft:
"Status: Degraded service in ap-south2. Impact start: 2026-03-15T14:19:20Z. We are actively routing traffic to ap-south1 and ap-southeast1 and expect continued mitigation actions over the next hour. If you require region-locked traffic, please contact support for a manual exception."

mira: posted to status page (public) with initial severity. URL: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2026-042

jordan: applied routing preference change (no downtime) and increased fallback weight to ap-south1/ap-southeast1. Observed immediate drop in error rate from 21% -> 6% over 3 minutes.

alex: peering provider responded: they saw SYN-ACK drops on a subset of their edge nodes. They're rolling a fix; ETA 25 minutes.

sam: assigning followups:
- mira: continue monitoring, capture pcap for the period 14:10-14:30
- jordan: coordinate global routing telemetry and verify no session affinity regressions
- alex: follow peering provider ticket and escalate to their oncall if ETA slips > 30m
- comms: prepare customer notification template for affected enterprise customers (include rollback/compensations)

mira: pcap collected and uploaded to s3: s3://redwood-incidents/inc-2026-042/pcap-ap-south2-14-10-14-30.pcap

comms: enterprise notification snippet (for PM review):
"We detected a partial network failure impacting inference egress from ap-south2 causing increased 5xx rates and latency. We have rerouted traffic to neighboring regions and are actively working with the peering provider to restore full service. We will provide updates every 15 minutes and will follow up with a post-incident report. If you experienced data loss or critical failure, reply to this thread and we'll prioritize."

jordan: adding operational note for runbook: when routing fallback is applied, ensure `kv-cache-ttl` is set to 60s for affected routes to avoid stale responses. Command: `redwoodctl config set route.ap-south2.kv-cache-ttl 60`

mira: monitoring dashboard shows error rate steady at 4-7% after reroute. latency normalized for most customers but some long-tail high p95s remain due to cold cache in target regions.

incident-bot: REMINDER: Handoff scheduled in 40 minutes. Current oncall mira -> sam. Ensure all actions and notes are in the incident ticket before handoff.

sam: i'll be taking the handoff at 1823459000. mira, please capture any outstanding tasks in the ticket.

mira: noted. adding checklist to ticket: investigation, peering ticket link, pcap location, routing changes applied, status page links, customer list.

alex: provider reports patch deployed and edge nodes recovering; monitoring their metrics now.

mira: after provider patch, error rate dropped to 1.2% and we reverted routing preference back to normal (ap-south2 preferred) at 1823457200.

comms: final status page update posted: "Service degraded — mitigated. Error rates returned to baseline after reroute and peering fix. Postmortem to follow."

sam: closing notes for handoff: confirmed no customer data loss, mitigations executed: routing fallback, scale up +2 nodes, cache-ttl tuning. Follow-up tasks: postmortem assigned to jordan (owner), alex to capture provider SLA impact.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: Severity downgraded to MONITORING. Incident will remain open for postmortem tasks.

mira: thanks all. great cross-team response. :thumbsup:
